title: What Child-Centered City Pilots Is
definition: Child-Centered City Pilots: pilots designing cities for children.
description:
Child-Centered City Pilots is pilots designing cities for children. It sits squarely in Future Cities & Habitats, the frontier where play streets science becomes pilot logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are traffic calming-scale. Societies that master pilot hulls early will shape school siting practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why play streets programs worldwide now treat Child-Centered City Pilots as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Child-Centered City Pilots needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

t: Real Research Today: Child-Centered City Pilots
title: Real Research Today: Child-Centered City Pilots
definition: Today's documented research behind Child-Centered City Pilots.
description:
The road to Child-Centered City Pilots is already being paved. The 15-minute city concept (Carlos Moreno, Paris) reorganizes urban life around proximity. China's sponge city program rebuilds urban water systems to absorb floodwater.

Saudi Arabia's NEOM project includes The Line, a 170 km linear car-free city concept under construction. Together these programs form the play streets foundation that Child-Centered City Pilots will build on — the pilot logistics results, the school siting methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as pilot logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2030 — The first pilot hulls district opens at 50
title: 2030 — The first pilot hulls district opens at 50
definition: 2030 milestone on the Child-Centered City Pilots roadmap.
description:
The first pilot hulls district opens at 50,000 residents, its play streets grid and pilot logistics mobility running at full design load.

What must be true first: the play streets results have to replicate outside the lab, pilot logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and school siting operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed play streets demonstrations, pilot logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting school siting uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Child-Centered City Pilots
definition: Estimates Child-Centered City Pilots readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Child-Centered City Pilots components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a pilot hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Child-Centered City Pilots Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Child-Centered City Pilots operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Child-Centered City Pilots installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 92756 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where play streets monitoring, pilot logistics redundancy, or school siting maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Child-Centered City Pilots Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Child-Centered City Pilots: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Child-Centered City Pilots — pilots designing cities for children.

Phase 1 — Prove (play streets): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (pilot logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (school siting): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (traffic calming): pilot hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and cities-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
